import_cycle.resolution: No definitions module was created. The cycle existed only while the sorry'd originals sat in Sobolev/Trace beside primed proofs that import them. Once the originals are deleted and the primes renamed in ManifoldTheorems, Sobolev.lean and Trace.lean hold only what both sides import, so they are the definitions modules. A separate MfdDefs.lean would not have broken anything further: the proofs need not only the definitions (gradNorm, IsC1, w12, IsLocallyLebesgue, IsBoundaryMeasure, Reads) but also the Euclidean inequalities sobolev_euclidean (Sobolev §1) and trace_critical (Trace §1), and the bridges need the model layer (SobolevIneq, TraceIneq, w12Sq, kobayashiB_of_sobolev). Moving all of that would have emptied Sobolev/Trace for no gain. This is the roadmap block's recipe (1)-(3).
import_cycle.chain_after: Yamabe.Negative <- Sobolev <- Trace <- HalfSpace <- Localisation <- ManifoldTheorems <- Compactness <- Rellich <- External. Rellich.lean now imports YamabeScaffold.Compactness instead of YamabeScaffold.Trace. Nothing upstream of Rellich imports it.
